diagnosis.financeiro: Having the money coming in and going out in one place is usually the first step to deciding with more confidence.
diagnosis.contas: Organizing due dates and incoming payments helps avoid delays and shows what is still coming in.
diagnosis.estoque: With quantities recorded, it is easier to know what you have, what is running low and what went out.
diagnosis.vendas: Bringing sales into a single panel shows what is working in each channel.
diagnosis.impostos: Recording taxes and due dates in one place helps you avoid surprises.
diagnosis.relatorios: Turning your entries into reports saves you from building everything by hand.
diagnosis.canais: Connecting your sales channels saves you from checking each panel separately.
diagnosis.tudo: When everything is together, you see the whole business at once and choose where to start.
diagnosis.visibilityGap: It seems you lack a clear view of how the business is doing. That is exactly what a single panel solves.

fluxoCaixa.name: Cash flow
fluxoCaixa.description: Shows money coming in and going out over time, with balance and transactions by category.
fluxoCaixa.benefit: You see how each transaction affects cash and plan commitments better.

contasPagar.name: Accounts payable
contasPagar.description: Records commitments with due dates and shows what is pending and what has been paid.
contasPagar.benefit: Helps avoid delays, fines and interest, with a clear view of what must be paid.

contasReceber.name: Accounts receivable
contasReceber.description: Tracks what your customers still owe, what has been received and what is open or overdue.
contasReceber.benefit: You know who owes what and when, without loose notes.

relatorios.name: Reports
relatorios.description: Turns your entries into analyses such as Cash Flow, Revenue, Expenses, income statement and Sales.
relatorios.benefit: You understand how the business is doing without building spreadsheets by hand.

estoque.name: Inventory
estoque.description: Registers products and tracks available quantities, with stock in and out.
estoque.benefit: You know what you have on hand and what is running out.

vendas.name: Sales panel
vendas.description: Brings together sales from connected channels and manual sales, with performance indicators.
vendas.benefit: A single view of what sells and where.

integracoes.name: Marketplace integrations
integracoes.description: Connects NexusFi to marketplaces such as Mercado Livre and TikTok Shop to bring in products and orders. You authorize the connection in the Inventory tab.
integracoes.benefit: Helps reduce typing and checking between panels.

impostos.name: Taxes
impostos.description: Records and tracks the company's taxes and their due dates.
impostos.benefit: You follow your obligations and get organized before they are due.

centroCustos.name: Cost centers
centroCustos.description: Organizes expenses by area, project or purpose within the company.
centroCustos.benefit: You understand where the money goes in each part of the business.

dashboard.name: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Gathers the main indicators in one place: period result, comparison with the previous period, cash projection, due dates and alerts.
dashboard.benefit: Helps you see the overall situation in seconds and act before a problem shows up.

cobrancaEmail.name: Email billing
cobrancaEmail.description: Sends billing emails from accounts receivable, with Pix copy-and-paste and due-date reminders. Part of the Pro plan.
cobrancaEmail.benefit: Helps make collecting payments simpler and more timely.

leitorNf.name: Invoice reader
leitorNf.description: Uses artificial intelligence to identify withholdings on invoices and create the entries. Part of the Pro plan.
leitorNf.benefit: Helps reduce typing and the risk of tax errors.

rh.name: HR
rh.description: Staff records, team cost, commissions and payroll with payslips. Part of the Pro plan.
rh.benefit: You track personnel cost alongside the rest of your finances.

pdv.name: POS (point of sale)
pdv.description: Point of sale with cash register opening and closing per shift. Part of the Pro plan.
pdv.benefit: Counter sales go straight into your records.

alertasWhatsapp.name: WhatsApp alerts
alertasWhatsapp.description: Sends the owner alerts about cash, inventory and bills through WhatsApp. Part of the Pro plan.
alertasWhatsapp.benefit: You get notified without opening the system.

overview: NexusFi brings together cash flow, payables and receivables, inventory, sales, taxes and reports in one place. Whenever you like, tell me about your business and I'll show what fits you.
